title: Dark Hunter
summary: An Obtenebration power that sends a shadow after a quarry.

claims.text: The Lasombra rolls Stamina + Leadership at difficulty 8, feeds the new shadow 5 Blood Points and invests a Willpower point to give it some permanence.
It acts only when given a target, which needs something belonging to the quarry so it can learn the spiritual signature.
The Hunter shares its creator’s Attributes and Willpower but can use only Unseen Presence; it must travel every step of the way, and vanishes once its mission is done.
It takes damage normally and from fire and sunlight, like a Night Shade.

title: Tchernabog
summary: A ninth-level Obtenebration power that blots out the sun.

claims.text: Named from a Slavic word for black god, the power covers the whole sky from horizon to horizon in darkness for exactly one hour, for two Willpower points.
Under it a vampire can walk at midday unharmed, and even torches and lanterns seem weak.
Only three Lasombra are known to have mastered it: Lasombra, Montano and a Greek Magister once called Boukephos, and none will teach it.

Smothering Darkness (Obtenebration 2, Obfuscate 1) makes one moth-like shadow per success on Wits + Occult at difficulty 6; each flies to the nearest flame up to torch size and puts it out, costing 9 experience.
Shadowed Eyes (Obtenebration 3, Auspex 3) blinds a target with patches of darkness on Dexterity + Occult at difficulty 7, lasting from one turn to an hour or more by successes.
The darkness covers every eye the victim has and can be removed only by plucking the eye out; a cosmetic version on the user’s own eyes can frighten onlookers into a Willpower roll at difficulty 5.

title: Koldunic Sorcery
summary: The old blood magic of the Tzimisce.

claims.text: Once famed sorcerers, the Tzimisce have been eclipsed by the Tremere, and only a few ancients still practise Koldunic Sorcery.

It works like Thaumaturgy but has no tie to Hermetic magic; its own paths and rituals cannot mix with Tremere magic, though work with House Tytalus has produced Koldunic versions of some Hermetic paths.
It is not a clan Discipline: a Tzimisce with a mentor learns it at out-of-clan cost, and no Fiend would teach an outsider; the first path is Spirit Ways.
Rituals are cast with Intelligence + Hearth Wisdom at difficulty 4 plus the ritual level, usually need a Blood Point per level and sometimes sacred earth, and are seldom written down.
Conjure Greater Demon, a level five ritual, calls a mighty entity of the Old Country that must be coaxed to serve and may destroy a sorcerer whose offer displeases it.
Create Vozhd, level six, joins at least fifteen ghouls fed each other’s blood into a war ghoul through Vicissitude and an unbroken chant lasting the number of ghouls minus seven hours.

Dracul, level nine, needs Vicissitude 6 as well; it turns the Fiend into a dragon with tripled Strength, doubled Stamina, Class 4 hide and acid breath, and only two Tzimisce, among them the Dracon, are known to have used it.

title: A Tzimisce bound to the land
summary: A power that makes a Fiend lord of a small domain.

claims.text: Always active once learned, it centres on a fiefdom of no more than about ten miles’ radius; Dominate, Presence, Animalism and Koldunic Sorcery are one difficulty easier there against natives.
The Fiend can sway the weather, shift landmarks to lose travellers and locate intruders with Intelligence + Hearth Wisdom rolls.
The Fiend is bound to the land, never leaves willingly, and if driven out withers as if cut off from native soil.

title: Sixth-level Vicissitude
summary: Entrail Saraband and the Living Testudo.

claims.text: Entrail Saraband costs a Blood Point and a health level as the bowels burst out to serve as whips, limbs or snares, granting extra dice for extra actions equal to Stamina.
The Living Testudo needs Strength 5: the Fiend lays open a restrained victim’s back and wields the body by its spine as a shield, reshaping its flesh into weapons while it lives.

title: Aura of Inescapable Truth
summary: A Ventrue combination power that forbids lies.

claims.text: With Dominate 4 and Presence 4, the Ventrue can make everyone within earshot unable to tell a deliberate lie; those who try choke on their words, though honest mistakes still come out.
The roll is Charisma + Leadership against the highest Willpower present, with a Willpower point per three targets, and like Dominate it touches only Cainites of weaker blood than the user.
One success covers the next statement and five the rest of the scene; it costs 21 experience to learn.
